d: Platinum white hair is styled in a long, flowing ponytail with blunt-cut bangs and a navy blue headband featuring a white crest. The eyes are a pale cornflower blue with a wide, curious expression on a youthful face of a teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white sleeveless dress with a navy blue collar and trim, paired with matching navy blue detached sleeves and thigh-high navy blue stockings tied with bows. Signature details include a silver chain draped across the chest and a large woven wicker basket carried by a rope strap.
